QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Republic] Dances with Wolves 1
QuestInfo.0: The Robed Lady has saved your hide three times already! This mysterious woman needs to be unmasked! See if you can find out who she really is.
QuestInfo.1: The Robed Lady has saved your hide three times already! This mysterious woman needs to be unmasked! But when you tried to talk to her, a roaming pack of Lupos came out of nowhere!
QuestInfo.2: The Robed Lady has saved your hide three times already! This mysterious woman needs to be unmasked! After you fended off the wolf attack, you found yourself in the middle of nowhere... It's dangerous out here.
